images.title: A prime product puzzle
images.purpose: Show the puzzle idea: a small grid whose empty cells are filled with prime numbers so each row and column multiplies to the number beside it.
images.composition: One 2 by 2 grid centred, row products to its right, column products below, one short line at the top.
images.exact_structure: One grid of exactly 4 equal empty square cells (2 rows, 2 columns) with a teal #0072B2 outline. To the right of row 1 the number 6, right of row 2 the number 10, both amber #E69F00. Below column 1 the number 10, below column 2 the number 6, both amber #E69F00. Above the grid, one grey #6B7280 line of text. Cells stay empty. Exactly 4 cells, 4 numbers, 1 line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any number written inside the grid cells
images.takeaway: Fill the cells with primes so each row and column multiplies to its number.
images.description: An empty 2 by 2 grid with row products 6 and 10 on the right and column products 10 and 6 below, headed fill with primes.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say what the product beside a row or column asks of the cells in it.

image_decisions.why: A puzzle grid with its products is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
